_about: What the issuers publish now: certifications, course certificates and badges in AI, data, cybersecurity, cloud and IT, from the tech giants and the certifying bodies. The registries (CareerOneStop, Credential Engine) lag the issuers by a year or more on AI credentials; this file closes that gap. kb/_build_it_ai_credential_catalog.py reads the verified rows. The industry-credential watch agent keeps it current (docs/reference/credential_watch_agent.md): it re-verifies rows, adds new credentials, and marks retirements. It never deletes a row -- a retired credential is still evidence a student holds.
_verified_by: The credential catalog session, 2026-09-30: research agents reading issuer pages and search results that quote them. Sam Lee asked for it: 'I am interested in all certs, but particularly emerging ones from the tech giants' and 'Not just certs, but courses that result in badges or certs as well.'
_method_caveat: Most rows were confirmed from search results quoting the issuer's page. The environment's network policy blocked direct fetches of aws.amazon.com, docs.aws.amazon.com, learn.microsoft.com, grow.google, coursera.org, credly.com, comptia.org and nvidia.com on 2026-09-30, and the session's 200 web searches ran out before every row was re-checked. 'evidence' names what was seen. Confirm a row on the issuer's own page before a college relies on it; rows with verified=false are held out of the catalog until a run confirms them.
_issuers_source: The research agents' issuer list, plus Anthropic and OpenAI from Sam's own watchlist (CPLBrain 03-professional/COMPETITIVE-WATCHLIST.md). A run re-reads that watchlist and adds any AI certification provider it names.
